changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 86 يجوز إبطال العقد للتدليس، ويعتبر تدليسا السكوت عمدا عن واقعة لو علمها المتعاقد لما أبرم العقد
changes.reason: [civil-code 86 ¶1] allows annulment for decisive stratagems of the party or his agent, and [civil-code 86 ¶2] makes deliberate silence fraud; cited as two statements.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 103 عند إبطال العقد يعاد المتعاقدان إلى الحالة التي كانا عليها قبل العقد
changes.reason: [civil-code 103 ¶1] restores the parties on annulment and adds equivalent compensation when restoration is impossible (request r6); ¶2 and ¶3 concern incapacity and illegality and are not cited.

changes.catalogueSays: cpca 17 دعوى تتعلق بعقار مشهر: يجب إشهار العريضة لدى المحافظة العقارية تحت طائلة عدم القبول
changes.reason: [cpca 17 ¶3] requires publication of a petition on a published property or real right, on pain of formal inadmissibility unless deposit is proven; the final module already carries it, so it is imported, not restated.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 324 مكرر 1 العقود الناقلة لملكية عقار تحرر في شكل رسمي تحت طائلة البطلان
changes.reason: [civil-code 324 مكرر 1 ¶1] supports the wording but makes the official form a condition of validity, not a rule of proof, and also requires the price to be paid before the public officer; kept as a limit for the absolute-nullity boundary and for the form of the contract and of payment.
Rests on [civil-code 86 ¶1] and [civil-code 86 ¶2].

changes.catalogueSays: إلزام المدعى عليه بإرجاع الثمن المقدر بـ (...) دج
changes.reason: Rests on [civil-code 103 ¶1]: restoration of the prior position includes returning the price.
Rests on [cpca 419 ¶1]: the losing party bears the costs.
Proves the contract the claim attacks under [civil-code 86 ¶1], and its official form where [civil-code 324 مكرر 1 ¶1] requires it.

changes.catalogueSays: ما يثبت الواقعة المكتومة أو الحيل
changes.reason: [civil-code 86 ¶2] and [civil-code 323 ¶1] put the proof of the fraud on the deceived party.

changes.catalogueSays: شهادة إشهار العريضة لدى المحافظة العقارية (إن تعلق الأمر بعقار مشهر)
changes.reason: [cpca 17 ¶3]; the final module's document already carries it (publication mention or proof of deposit), so it is imported.

[civil-code 86 ¶1] (stratagems) and [civil-code 86 ¶2] (deliberate silence).

Return of what the plaintiff delivered (seller position), under [civil-code 103 ¶1].

Equivalent compensation when restoration is impossible, [civil-code 103 ¶1].

[civil-code 101 ¶2] outer limit counted from the conclusion of the contract; interpretive, warns.
Rescission for non-performance, [civil-code 119 ¶1].

Hidden-defects warranty, [civil-code 379 ¶2], [civil-code 383 ¶1] and [civil-code 383 ¶2].
Lesion in the sale of real property, [civil-code 358 ¶1].
